data.long_meaning: Danika is a Slavic name derived from the elements dani, meaning 'God,' and ka, meaning 'judge.' This name reflects the belief that God is the ultimate judge of a person's actions and deeds. In Christian tradition, it is a reminder of the Day of Judgment and the importance of living a righteous life. The name Danika carries the meaning “God is my judge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. in_greek.name: Ντανίκα
